Move the pinned Claude Code CLI to 2.1.318 (#294)

CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION at line 61 of .github/workflows/plugin-validate.yml
moves from 2.1.310 to 2.1.318. That line is the only pin of the Claude
Code CLI: the Plugin manifests job installs the CLI at that version
(line 75), and the plugin_manifests step of tools/run_all_checks.sh
reads the pin with sed (line 66) and refuses to validate when claude
--version on the host reports another version (lines 75 to 82). The
maintainer decided on 2026-11-27 to move the pin to 2.1.318, the
version that the host CLI reports, so that CI and the local full gate
validate the manifests with the same CLI.

8 lines keep 2.1.310 on purpose, because none of them is the pin:

- 6 comments and docstrings that describe the workflow shape check and
  give 2.1.310 as an example of a dotted version number, at
  .github/workflows/plugin-validate.yml:36,
  .github/workflows/ci-status-test.yml:20,
  .github/workflows/agent-plugin-manifest.yml:20,
  .github/workflows/skill-discovery.yml:17, tools/ci-status.py:104 and
  tools/test-ci-status.sh:1846;
- 2 fixtures of tools/test-run-all-checks.py, crlf.yml (line 539) and
  two-pins.yml (line 541), files from which read_pin must take no pin,
  where the version is only test data.

tools/run_all_checks.sh does not change, so SCRIPT_SHA256 in
tools/test-run-all-checks.py keeps its value.

Checks, each run from the repository root:

python3 -I tools/test-run-all-checks.py exits 0 and prints this on 1
line:

    OK: 19 workflows, 83 run steps, 72 command lines in
    tools/run_all_checks.sh, 10 behaviour cases, 17 reading cases

So read_pin finds exactly 1 pin in plugin-validate.yml, and the sha256
of tools/run_all_checks.sh still equals SCRIPT_SHA256.

bash tools/test-ci-status.sh exits 0 and ends with:

    all ci-status github-actions fail-safe tests pass

Among its lines is this one, which shows that the workflow, with the
new pin, still passes the shape check:

    ok   required check Plugin manifests follows plugin-validate.yml

grep -rn '2\.1\.310' .github tools lists the 8 lines above and no
other.

Not run for this change: tools/run_all_checks.sh, whose
plugin_manifests step needs claude 2.1.318 on the host, and the
Plugin manifests job in CI.
